title: Clinic website acceptance test
description: Test the tasks visitors need to complete on a phone before a clinic website goes live.
answer: Start with four tasks: find the right location, identify an appropriate contact, submit a test enquiry, and recover from a form error. Record the result and assign an owner before launch.
rows: The branch name, address, hours and phone number agree with the approved branch record.
The contact or enquiry option clearly names the location or department that handles it.
A labelled test request reaches the assigned inbox, and the confirmation explains what happens next.
A missing or incorrect field is identified in text and valid entries are retained.
The menu, links and form can be reached in order without clipping or losing focus.
Device or browser and failed step
example: If a mobile visitor chooses a branch and the form routes the enquiry to a different branch, record the selected location, destination inbox and request reference. Repeat the test after correcting the routing.

title: Healthcare listing update log
description: Track a change to clinic hours, phone numbers or location details across the website and business listings.
answer: Start with one approved branch record. Note what changed, who confirmed it, which channels need updating and when the published change was checked.
rows: First Saturday of the revised schedule
Branch contact page and the authorized Business Profile
Confirm both surfaces show the approved hours after the update appears.
example: A submitted edit is still pending until someone checks the public listing. Track each channel separately so a website update is not mistaken for a listing update.

title: Healthcare content review sheet
description: Assign ownership, evidence and approval for facts on service, practitioner and location pages.
answer: Record each factual claim beside its source, owner and next review trigger. Give priority to information that changes how visitors reach the organization or choose an appropriate next step.
rows: Exact page URL and sentence or field
Physiotherapy service page / home visits offered
Document or record supporting that exact claim
Approved service list for the branch
Person who can confirm the fact
Service availability confirmed for the named branch
Date or change that should trigger a check
New branch, change to service list or scheduled review
Remove outdated wording; recheck the published page
example: When a service stops at one location, update the branch record first. Then check the service page, location page and contact options for stale references.

title: Clinic enquiry routing map
description: Map each enquiry type to a team, fallback and response before configuring forms or a CRM.
answer: For each enquiry, name the receiving team, the minimum information it needs and the backup if nobody is available. Test the handoff with fictional details before launch.
rows: Front desk at the selected branch
Send to the central desk if a branch is unavailable; record whether a time was agreed.
Use the published contact information; update the branch page if it is wrong.
Name a backup owner; acknowledge receipt and assign a follow-up.
Direct visitors to the approved secure channel; keep reports out of general enquiry forms.
Check the queue during staffed hours, route the enquiry and record who accepted it.
example: Submit a fictional appointment request for each branch. Check that the correct team sees it and that the message says a request was received, without implying an appointment has already been confirmed.
